observations: A stack of four car tires.
The top tire sidewall clearly displays 'MICHELIN' and 'PRIMACY 4'.
The tire size '225/55 R 17' is visible on the sidewall of the top tire.
White and purple labels/stickers are attached to the tread of the tires, suggesting they are unused.
The tread pattern is visible and appears deep.
A watermark 'EAZY WAY TYRES' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' is overlaid on the image.
The DOT date code (manufacture date) is not visible in the photo.

claims.evidence: Subjective marketing statement; quality depends on age and storage which cannot be fully verified remotely.
This is a manufacturer's design intent for this model, but actual performance depends on the tire's current condition and age.

risks.risk: The tires may be old stock or expired (rubber degrades over time).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the 4-digit DOT code located in an oval on the sidewall.

risks.risk: The bottom three tires may not match the top tire in brand, model, or size.
risks.proof: Photos of the sidewalls of all four tires showing matching specifications.

risks.risk: Internal structural damage or dry rot not visible from this angle.
risks.proof: Close-up video of the sidewalls and inside the carcass while flexing the rubber.

proof_requests: Photo of the 4-digit DOT code on each tire to verify the manufacture date.
Photos of the sidewalls of the other three tires to confirm they are the same brand, model, and size.
Clear photo of the full sidewall of the top tire to check for any 'regrooved' markings or repairs.
response.reason: The brand, model, and size are clearly identifiable. The tires appear unused due to the presence of tread stickers, but they must be priced as old stock until a recent manufacture date is proven via the DOT code.
